source_text: Article 24(3) of the UNCRC is referenced to condemn traditional practices prejudicial to children's health, positioning genital mutilations as harmful customs that states must abolish through effective measures, aligning with World Health Organization recommendations from 1994 urging legal instruments against such acts.
